\begin{example} \end{example}[Boundary Normal Coordinates] ↗ prop:double-manifold 1. ch6:6.44

Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold with nonempty boundary. Embed $M$ in its double $\widetilde M$, extend $g$ smoothly, and choose Fermi coordinates $(x^1,\ldots ,x^{n-1},v)$ for $\partial M$ in $\widetilde M$. After replacing $v$ by $-v$ if necessary, require $v>0$ on $\operatorname {Int}M$. Their restrictions to $M$ are semigeodesic boundary coordinates, called boundary normal coordinates. \end{example}
